review.title: Drain review: `county-board-open-week-1`, the in-game county board reads the open week (Opus 5.5 implementer at max effort; F-LSR1-1)

bookkeeping.rowText: Door shape (a): the public board GET accepts `?rotation=<id>` or `?rotation=open` (resolved through `currentOrLatestRotation`) inside the strict parameter arithmetic and serves that week's rows with party sizes, difficulty, `heldOutFor` and the three counts unchanged; a week unknown, not yet open or not carrying the contract answers 400 `bad_rotation`; the unfiltered board is byte-identical (15 requests through both doors on one ledger and one clock: 8 identical, 7 changed, each one the old door refused). In the game, County Standings opens a rotation contract on the week a live run rides, labelled from `liveSeedLabel` ('Week 39 claim'), with 'All time' one tap away; a secured live run posted to the in-process door (rank 1, `rotationId` r2026w39) and the player's own row showed on the board they opened. Boot writes nothing. Spec `e2e/county-board-open-week.spec.ts` 10/10 both projects; live-seed-rotation, tl-02, task-025, m2-01 52/52; `test:stats` rc 0 with 13 new checks; three planted defects (the door ignoring the week, admitting an unopened week, the reader never naming the week) each caught by the right test and restored byte for byte; the door half alone hash-neutral. `e2e/assay-season-roll.spec.ts` opens the all-time board before its constant-seed assertion under a named lift (F-CBW1-1). Engine hash PINNED {PIN} (the reader's bytes and one `liveSeed.ts` export). Reds attributed on a clean base: 12 board reds and 6 agent-reels rows are pre-existing stale fixtures (F-LC2-13 among them), node-guards 6 (the two pre-pin registry rows, the linked-worktree desk guard, the missing `.env.local` rows). F-CBW1-4 (the public door document names `?rotation=`) by the cure; F-CBW1-7 (a week view in the Field Book) and F-CBW1-6 (regenerate the same-game audit) DEFERRED.
